label: SearchNeed status policy

status_meanings.unresolved: A local explicit input suggests unresolved search work.
status_meanings.weakly_resolved: A local input has weak or near-match material but needs review.
status_meanings.source_gap: A local input suggests source work may be needed.
status_meanings.capability_gap: A local input suggests future capability work may be needed.
status_meanings.not_evaluable: The input is not shaped enough for useful review.

no_truth_claim_rules: SearchNeed status never means accepted public truth.
SearchNeed status never means accepted evidence truth.
no_exhaustive_absence_rules: A local unresolved SearchNeed cannot prove source-universe absence.
Review may approve future seeds only.
notes: Current statuses are descriptive and review-gated.
